topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't help but think of my boy, where he might be now, as I hear tales of folks finding old toys at a sale. It's like finding a bit of the past, a reminder of a time when the world was simple and small, like the Plot we tend. I was out in the field, sowing seeds, when I heard the story. It made my hands tremble and I almost missed a row. The thought of such a find sends a chill down my spine, like the autumn wind before the storm. I can't shake the images it brings, the memories of my own lad, smiling, holding his own little bear, before the world got hold of him. The soil beneath my feet is hard and unforgiving, just like the way the years have passed.
